scripts.build: vite build && node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { let html = fs.readFileSync('dist/index.html', 'utf-8'); html = html.replace(/new URL\(([`'"])([^`'"]+)\1/g, (m, q, f) => !f.startsWith('assets/') && !f.startsWith('./assets/') ? 'new URL(' + q + 'assets/' + f + q : m); html = html.replace(/url\([\"']?\/assets\//g, 'url(\"./assets/'); fs.writeFileSync('../index.html', html); if (fs.existsSync('dist/assets')) { fs.cpSync('dist/assets', '../assets', { recursive: true }); } console.log('Built and patched index.html with assets/ prefix'); })"
